summary: Phase 1A + 1B verification. Backend: all 8 new pytest cases pass — admin unlimited bypass, refNumber TYPE-INITIALS-YYMMDD-NNN format, DOCUMENT REFERENCE/DATE/REVIEW DATE header, no em/en dashes, auto-save to /api/documents with autoSaved=true, free-tier (sparky-style fresh signup) still capped at 3 tools and isUnlimited=false. Frontend partially verified: Enterprise £199.99 on landing, 4 yellow asterisks (rgb(232,160,32)) on RAMS, Generate button disabled when empty / enabled when filled, code-level confirmation of SMS action button (data-testid='action-sms') + new disclaimer wording in ToolHeader.jsx. Visual E2E of result panel (REF badge, SMS button, disclaimer, toast) is BLOCKED because the Emergent LLM budget is exhausted (Max budget 0.4 reached) — /api/generate returns 500 from the chat layer for live UI clicks. Site Diary date prefill is BROKEN: tools-config.js line 49 declares the date field as type='text' (default), so autoDefaultFor() never fires and the field stays empty.

critical.issue: Emergent LLM budget exhausted (budget_exceeded, current 0.440718 > max 0.4). All live UI generations now return 500 / 502 with ChatError. Backend logic itself is correct (test_phase1ab_admin_refnumber.py passed all 8 cases when budget was available). Either bump the budget for this preview env or document this in the test report. This blocks all subsequent E2E Generate flows.

ui_bugs.issue: Site Diary 'date' field is declared as f('date','Date') in /app/frontend/src/lib/tools-config.js line 49, which defaults to type='text'. autoDefaultFor() only injects today when field.type==='date', so the field renders empty instead of today's ISO date. Same issue likely affects multiuser-site-diary (line 217) and quote-builder validUntil (line 54). Fix: change to f('date','Date','date') OR widen autoDefaultFor() to also key off field.name (e.g. /date|review/) regardless of type.

Review request says data-testid='generate-button' but the actual rendered testid on the Generate button is 'generate-btn'. Documentation/spec drift — not a code bug, but future tests should use 'generate-btn'.

integration_issues.issue: Could not visually verify REF badge ('REF: <number>'), DOCUMENT REFERENCE header in result, SMS/Email/WhatsApp action buttons, 'Saved to your Vault' toast, or new disclaimer wording on screen — every live click on Generate returns 500 due to the exhausted Emergent LLM budget. Code-level inspection confirms ToolHeader.jsx renders action-sms (line 135) and the exact disclaimer text (line 143); GenericToolPage.jsx renders refNumber on a passing API response and emits the success toast.

critical_code_review_comments: tools-config.js field helper f(name,label,type='text',...) silently defaults date-named fields to text — easy footgun. Suggest a stricter helper d(name,label) for date fields or auto-promote field.name matching /date|review|validUntil/i to type='date' in the helper.
GenericToolPage.autoDefaultFor() only checks field.type. Defensive improvement: also key on field.name pattern (date|review|validUntil) so a misconfigured field still gets a sensible default.

ChatError in /api/generate currently bubbles up as a 500 from the backend (server.py:430). Could be wrapped to return a friendlier 503 / structured error so the UI toast can surface 'AI service temporarily unavailable' instead of the generic 'Generation failed'.

The cookie banner Accept button must be clicked before scrolling to Generate. Site Diary's date field bug confirmed in tools-config.js line 49.
rca of the issue: Bug 1 (Site Diary date not prefilled): root cause is f('date','Date') in tools-config.js line 49 inheriting the default type='text' from the helper signature; GenericToolPage.autoDefaultFor (line 20-25) gates today's ISO injection behind field.type==='date', so the field is never seeded. Reproduction: navigate to /app/tool/site-diary while authenticated → inspect input[data-testid='field-date'] → value is empty string. Fix: change to f('date','Date','date') OR loosen autoDefaultFor to also match field.name. Bug 2 (Generate 500/502 via UI): root cause is litellm budget_exceeded — Emergent LLM key has hit its 0.4 USD cap. Reproduction: any authenticated POST /api/generate with valid payload now raises emergentintegrations.llm.chat.ChatError which server.py:430 lets bubble to a 500. Mitigation: top up / reset the Emergent LLM budget; wrap ChatError into a 503 with friendlier message.
